items.reason: A gentle cleanser with no actives keeps young skin feeling clean and comfortable.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's moisture and comfort without anything strong.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection that suits young skin.

response.routine_note: We've left out the strong retinol, vitamin C serum and 30% peel because those products are not suitable for children under 13, so please check with a parent or guardian and a dermatologist before trying any active products. Cleanse gently morning and night, moisturize, and apply the mineral SPF every morning.
